_comment: PSST (D90): PUBLIC (GM) Xcode releases allowed for iOS builds, with the iOS SDK build each ships. Source: developer.apple.com/news/releases (checked 2026-11-20) + `xcrun --sdk iphoneos --show-sdk-build-version` on the runner (workflow ios-xcode-inventory.yml). Betas (e.g. Xcode 27.3 beta 27C5020n, SDK 24C5037e) must NEVER be added. When Apple ships a new GM Xcode: add it here and move `store`.
